messages:
alex: FYI noticed after the role-tag sync at 10:12 UTC a few service accounts ended up with analytics.dataset:read. looks like a mapping drift

morgan: which svc accounts? can you paste the sync output? @sec-oncall please ping in case this is wider

ops-bot: role-tag-sync job completed (job_id: rsync-2026-03-20-1012) — 124 entries processed, 3 diffs applied

alex: svc-analytics-ingest, svc-metrics-frontend, svc-aml-batch. saw reads against customer_dataset buckets at 10:14 from svc-metrics-frontend

jamal: copying logs: ```
# rsync diff snippet
- svc-metrics-frontend: tags -> [metrics, readonly]
+ svc-metrics-frontend: tags -> [metrics, readonly, analytics.dataset:read]
```

morgan: ugh. that extra analytics tag shouldn't be added by rsync. which mapping rule added it? recent PR that changed "derived-claims" logic?

tara: I think #4829 touched claim->role derivation. it added `if tag.namespace == "analytics" then add dataset:read` unintentionally matching our metrics tag.

sec-oncall: thanks. triage steps: 1) prevent further propagation 2) contain current exposure 3) assess access events 4) rollback/migrate fix

jamal: Preventing propagation: paused the rsync job (job_id rsync-2026-03-20-1012) and disabled scheduled runs. Confirmed pause at 10:18 UTC.

morgan: Containment — can we add a deny override for the dataset read permission on those svc accounts? or revoke tokens?

alex: Quick wins: 1) add RBAC deny rule for analytics.dataset:read scoped to service accounts in svc-* for 1 hour 2) revoke long-lived tokens for the three services 3) block KMS decrypts by adding deny to kms:Decrypt for the affected roles until we validate

tara: I pushed a short-lived deny override: ```
rbac.overrides.apply({
  selector: "service:svc-*-frontend,svc-analytics-ingest,svc-aml-batch",
  deny: ["analytics.dataset:read"],
  expires_at: "2026-03-20T11:30:00Z"
})
```

ops-bot: RBAC override applied (override_id: ov-6643), expires 2026-03-20T11:30:00Z

jamal: Revoked tokens for svc-metrics-frontend and svc-analytics-ingest. svc-aml-batch uses ephemeral creds; rotated its certs as precaution.

morgan: KMS check: any decrypt events by those svc accounts?

sec-oncall: Querying CloudKMS logs... no Decrypt events attributed to these service accounts in the 10:00-10:30 window. looks like read was limited to object-list and metadata requests so far. still bad though.

alex: Good catch. Need to validate no customer data was exfil'd. @jamal can you run a quick S3 access audit for the bucket prefixes accessed by svc-metrics-frontend between 10:12-10:20?

jamal: Running query now: found HEAD/GET on objects under customer-data-prod/customer_*/meta.json — 18 objects accessed across 5 customers. content-size small (metadata only) but still unauthorized. logging full object GETs showed none.

morgan: OK scope: metadata exposure only, no full object reads, no KMS decrypts. That reduces blast radius but still requires disclosure to legal for potential PII leakage in metadata.

tara: Root cause: claim derivation rule matched `metrics` tag due to loose pattern in PR #4829. proposed fix: tighten rule to `tag == "analytics.metrics"` and add explicit allowlist for tags we will map to dataset read.

alex: Can we rollback mapping code to previous commit immediately?

morgan: I've opened emergency rollback PR to revert #4829 and redeploy mapping service. assign to me and jamal. aiming to deploy in 20m.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: deploy started for mapping-service @ morgan (deploy-9876)

jamal: deploy finished, mapping-service v1.13.4 -> v1.13.5-rollback (commit abc123-revert), verified unit tests and integration smoke: no analytics.dataset tag generated in test matrix

morgan: Re-ran rsync dry-run locally against staging rules — no additional diffs. schedule safe to re-enable once we confirm audits.

sec-oncall: Next immediate actions: 1) confirm revoke/deny successful (done) 2) run full access audit for 24h window (jamal) 3) notify legal and CISO on possible metadata exposure (tara) 4) plan for postmortem and stricter test coverage for derived-claims rules (morgan)

tara: Notifying legal and privacy now. drafting a short incident note for customer-facing teams, will share in #incidents once approved.

alex: One more — add an alert for sudden tag->role deltas in rsync (threshold > 2 unexpected tag additions) and a circuit-breaker to pause job automatically. logged ticket INFRA-2217

morgan: I'll add integration guardrails and a unit test for tag pattern matching. also create a canary job that runs in preview mode first.

jamal: I'll produce the audit CSV and attach to the incident thread. early findings: 5 customers with metadata hits, all entries logged and retained per retention policy.

sec-oncall: Triage complete for now. keep this thread updated if you find any full object reads or KMS decrypts. postmortem owner: morgan, timeline draft due 2026-03-21 18:00 UTC

alex: thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

morgan: closing the immediate triage; will follow up with postmortem and remediation PRs.

ops-bot: note: RBAC override ov-6643 will auto-expire at 2026-03-20T11:30:00Z unless extended.
